senses.gloss: (v. לָעַז) to talk about, sneer, talk disrespectfully.
<cite ref="L00228">same</cite>. Y. Dem. II, 22ᶜ bot. <he>היו הכל מְלִיזִין עליו</he> all people talked against him.
units: <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 4:12:1">Cant. R. to IV, 12</cite> <he>ושמע קול הבריות מליזין אחר וכ׳</he> heard the people talk evil of his daughters.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 54:4">Gen. R. s. 54</cite> <he>מליזין בארון</he> spoke disrespectfully of the ark (v.
<cite ref="Sotah 35a">Sot. 35ᵃ</cite> sq.); a. fr.—Y. Shek. V, 49ᵃ bot. <he>מליזין</he> (some Bab. ed. <he>מַלְעִיזִין</he>).
